title: Luxury Scottsdale Home | Pool & Heated Spa
description:
Modern hideaway that blends thoughtful design and comfort in a newly renovated 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom retreat nestled in one of Scottsdale's top neighborhoods. This home offers a seamless balance of style and relaxation. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a luxurious space where you can unwind, entertain, and make lasting memories. Whether you're here for a quick getaway or a more extended stay, this retreat invites you to experience Arizona in the best way possible.

 The space 
Why You'll Love Your Unique Experience at The Desert Hideaway:

• Pet Friendly! Pets are welcome for an extra $50 (per night) pet fee. 
• Luxurious Furnishings: Relax and unwind in style amidst tastefully appointed furnishings throughout the house.
• Inviting Pool: The pool is gated, and guests can take a refreshing dip or lounge poolside under the sun. Pool can be heated Mid May-Mid September only (heating is a $100/day extra) 
• Heated Spa available year-round! 
• Outdoor BBQ: Grill up delectable meals on the built-in BBQ, adding a sizzle to your evenings.
• Outdoor Oasis: Retreat to the outdoor lounge area, where a charming pergola provides shade and creates an inviting, relaxing space.
• Gourmet Kitchen: The chef's kitchen has top-of-the-line appliances, making it a dream come true for food enthusiasts. A private chef can be recommended upon request.
• Four Dining areas 
• Three living areas
• Entertainment Galore: Upstairs hangout room with pool table, board games, shuffleboard, and more!
• Outdoor Firepit: Plenty of seating
• Take advantage of our cozy in-home Fitness Center, equipped with a treadmill, a bike, a bench, and a stand with free weights.
• Fun for All Ages: Challenge friends and family to games of corn hole or board games, ensuring endless laughter and memories.
• Designated work area in each bedroom

Sleeping Arrangements & Bathrooms (Sleeps 12 Comfortably):

Primary Suite 1: Two Queens 
Bedroom 2: One Queen
Bedroom 3: One Queen
Bedroom 4: One King
Bedroom 5: One Queen

Every corner of this residence exudes careful consideration, fostering an exceptional living experience. The open-concept layout effortlessly facilitates gatherings and cherished moments with your loved ones.

The centerpiece of this home is the chef’s kitchen, fully equipped with premium appliances that inspire culinary creativity. This impressive space includes a built-in BBQ, a comfortable seating area, a shimmering pool, a relaxing hot tub, and a dog run. Very kid-friendly! 

For those seeking more than just a place to stay—an experience that caters to refined tastes and elevates every moment—this remarkable resort-style home awaits. Reserve your stay today and immerse yourself in luxury.

 Guest access 
You'll enter and exit through the front door. Keypad code provided before check-in.
